sentences.en: Fans grew accustom to the "I'm a doctor not a…." one liners made famous by DeForest Kelley who played Dr. Leonard McCoy in the original series.

sentences.en: Trinneer's delivery is a mixture of DeForest Kelley's Bones and Jimmy Doohan's Scotty.

sentences.en: DeForest Kelley who played Leonard "Bones" McCoy in the original series made a guest appearance in the first episode of TNG as an admiral of 137 years of age.

sentences.en: The fires are likely to permanently deforest the land.

sentences.en: Two thirds of the region has been deforested in the past decade.

sentences.en: When we pollute and deforest and make a mess of the ecological web, we're taking out mortgages on the Earth that we can't pay back — and those loans will come due.
sentences.vi: Khi chúng ta gây ô nhiễm, phá rừng và làm xáo trộn mạng lưới sinh thái, chúng ta đang lấy đi các khoản thế chấp trên Trái đất mà chúng ta không thể trả lại - và những khoản vay đó sẽ đến hạn trả.

sentences.en: People believe they can deforest illegally because sooner or later all will be forgiven, " said Philip Fearnside of the government's National Institute for Amazon Research.
